reason: s30 rejected hard persistence; distinguish elapsed-clock information from changing flow or auxiliary inputs
evidence_class: adaptive exploratory follow-up on the same already-exposed sample
sample: identical frozen 32 train and 20 valid rowgroups from HYPOTHESES.json; no selection changes

fixed_procedure.fit_and_metric: identical stride, normalization, ridge penalty and clipped weighted correlation to s30; no target-derived regime inputs

models.anchor: all 20 raw representatives and sentinel indicators at last a6 reset
models.anchor_clocks: anchor features except current a5,a6,a7 and their indicators
models.anchor_flow: anchor features except current i0/i1 v0,v11,dv0 and their indicators
models.anchor_aux: anchor features except current a0..a7 and their indicators
models.current_held_clocks: all current features except a5,a6,a7 held at last a6 reset
models.current: all current features; reproduce s30 control

fixed_procedure.matched_control: same sample, feature dimension, train normalization, regularization and weights; only the time at which a frozen feature block is read differs
fixed_procedure.prefix_check: full-stream reset indices must equal prefix recomputation at cutoffs 99,641,1501 on train104 and valid6, for true,price and five delayed streams

tests.hypothesis: current a5..a7 account for at least 80% of the mean-WP gap between anchor-only and current-input ridge
tests.inference: last reset inputs plus current clocks; no final run duration

tests.hypothesis: updating the six v/dv representatives adds at least 0.02 mean WP over anchor-only ridge
tests.inference: current v/dv inputs plus cached anchor inputs; economic interpretation remains unverified

limitations: models are small linear diagnostics; block associations do not prove physical causation; same exposed sample and adaptive test
